Context: 2. Leave Travel Concession

## 2. Leave Travel Concession  
- (a) Government servant who leaves his family behind and does not avail transfer T.A. for the family will have the option to choose-  
Utaer: The existing LTC to Home Town once in a block of two calendar years and/or one 'Anywhere in India' LTC in .a block of four y.ears under the normal LTC Rules;
